title: Disc
description: A pressed Abbey Road CD on the table: spin it by the edge and the print turns while the rainbow stays pinned to the light, then turn it over to the label and drop it into a portable player whose lid snaps shut, spins up and counts the track time on its LCD.
intent: One real optical material: the data side is a 1.6 µm groove grating, so the diffraction colours are computed from the light, the eye and the groove direction and stay fixed while the disc spins under them.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage, the spinning CD
